[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T13:32:38Z, by staff] Englobe, a Colliers Company, Completes Acquisition of Reinbold Engineering Group
Englobe, a subsidiary of Colliers International Group Inc., has finalized its acquisition of Calgary-based mechanical engineering firm Reinbold Engineering Group.
Englobe, a Canadian engineering and environmental services firm and a subsidiary of Colliers International Group Inc., has completed the acquisition of Reinbold Engineering Group. The transaction adds over 90 team members from Reinbold to Englobe's national platform, with offices in Calgary, Edmonton, Kelowna, Vancouver, and Toronto. This acquisition is intended to strengthen Englobe's capabilities in mechanical engineering, energy modelling, commissioning, and sustainable building design. Reinbold's clients will now have access to Englobe's broader national engineering and environmental services.

What changed: a tuck-in at a subsidiary. Ninety people against a $4.7B parent is immaterial, and Colliers did not disclose a price, which it would have to for anything material.
Price: CIGI -0.2% since the item, on 572 IEX shares.
objections: Immaterial subsidiary tuck-in; no terms, no parent filing.
